source_name: EMA Association (Ukrainian Interbank Association of Payment System Members) — members & partners lists
why_relevant: Industry body since 1999 whose membership spans payment systems, banks, financial companies, payment providers and MFOs. Its member/partner directory is the best non-regulatory actor map for this cell, and its events/working groups expose named executives by function (fraud, acquiring, e-com).

source_name: ОТП Банк — Банк у ЗМІ (bank in the media)
why_relevant: A bank-curated index of third-party media coverage. Excellent snowball surface: it names which Ukrainian outlets cover this bank, and often links interviews with newly appointed executives that are not in the press-release stream.

source_name: European Business Association (EBA Ukraine) member directory — scheme representative offices
why_relevant: Lists the legal representative offices of foreign schemes in Ukraine (e.g. 'Представництво Мастеркард Юроп СА') with named contact leadership, and EBA committee rosters reveal which scheme executives hold Ukraine-facing roles.

source_name: minfin.com.ua — company cards for izibank and UA banks
why_relevant: Consumer-finance portal with per-institution cards (licence, МФО, ЄДРПОУ, news, reviews); a convenient entity-resolution layer linking neobank brands to their licensed banks.

source_name: InVenture — «10 корисних Telegram-каналів про бізнес, фінанси та інвестиції»
why_relevant: Second independent channel directory; overlaps only partially with the Minfin list, so it widens handle discovery for finance/investment channels where banker moves get discussed.

source_name: Мінфін (minfin.com.ua) — FinAwards ranking of Ukrainian finance influencers, YouTube and Telegram channels
why_relevant: Annually enumerates the most-followed Ukrainian finance Telegram channels and personal influencers — the fastest way to expand the weak-signal channel list without guessing handles. Rerun each year for the refreshed list.

source_name: НКЦПФР — інформаційні бази та реєстри професійних учасників ринків капіталу
why_relevant: The securities regulator's register of licensed professional participants (traders, depositories, asset managers) enumerates the non-bank capital-market actors in scope and links to their disclosure cabinets, extending the entity watchlist beyond NBU-licensed institutions.

source_name: NABU member-organisation profile pages (member directory)
why_relevant: NABU hosts per-member profile pages (banks and partner associations alike — the example is its profile of the Ukrainian Association of Fintech and Innovation Companies). The directory is effectively a curated map of every banking-sector actor worth scouting, and each profile links out to the member's own site, which is where its own leadership pages live.

source_name: НАБУ (National Association of Banks of Ukraine) — member bank pages
why_relevant: Industry association member directory. Useful as an actor-map spine (canonical legal names, АТ prefixes, contacts) and for association-level news where bank executives take committee roles — a soft but real indicator of seniority and mandate changes.

source_name: Незалежна асоціація банків України (НАБУ) — комітети та галузеве представництво
why_relevant: Sector association whose committee structure, member list and events map who speaks for banks on regulatory and workforce matters; useful as an actor-map pointer and to reach bank HR practitioners, even though it currently has no dedicated HR committee.

source_name: LinkedIn — Ukrainian Interbank Payment Systems Member Association "EMA" (ЄМА)
why_relevant: Payments-industry association whose page and event posts tag member-bank payment executives by name and role — an efficient way to snowball an up-to-date actor map of who runs cards/payments at each bank.

source_name: Opendatabot — Банки України (перелік діючих банків)
why_relevant: Ready-made, EDRPOU-linked list of operating state and private banks that maps each bank straight into its ЄДР card, shortening the path from 'which entities are in scope' to 'who currently signs for them'.

source_name: IT Ukraine Association — member directory and Top-50 IT company rankings
why_relevant: Publishes the ranked list of the largest Ukrainian IT companies by specialist headcount, including the integrators serving banks (SoftServe, Ciklum, Infopulse, N-iX, EPAM). Headcount rankings over time are a clean org-change/expansion metric and the directory snowballs into vendor domains to monitor.

source_name: AUB — Members list
why_relevant: 70+ member organisations including state and commercial banks plus non-bank financial companies — the complementary actor map to EMA's (banking-weighted rather than payments-weighted), and the union of the two is close to a full census of the addressable market.

source_name: about.robota.ua — corporate/press section
why_relevant: Company/press page linking to robota.ua's press releases, datasets, partnerships and API/product notes; a route to formal data-access requests rather than scraping.

source_name: LIGA File (file.liga.net) — person dossiers / biographical database
why_relevant: Structured dossier database of Ukrainian public and business figures with photo, biography and career track. This is the highest-value pointer in this cell: it converts a name found in an appointment headline into a career timeline and prior employer set, and can be used to build the A5 actor map for Ukrainian banking executives.

source_name: Wikipedia (uk/en) — Fintech-IT Group, monobank, Горохівський
why_relevant: Cheap, footnoted baseline for the actor map: corporate structure, founder roles, headcount figures (800+ employees, Feb 2026) and citation trails to primary sources. Not a signal source itself.

source_name: Wikipedia (uk/en) — institutional leadership lists
why_relevant: Maintained succession lists (e.g. 'Список голів Національного банку України') and executive biographies give a free, structured historical baseline of tenure start/end dates, and their reference sections point back to the original media announcements — a cheap way to bootstrap the A5 historical timeline before live monitoring starts.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox — procurement knowledge base and practitioner articles
why_relevant: Official Prozorro editorial channel explaining procedures, tools and case studies, including NBU procurement practice and EBRD procurement opportunities in Ukraine. Good for learning the vocabulary and locating adjacent portals and donor channels.

source_name: 10times — Ukraine finance/banking conference listings
why_relevant: Third-party event aggregator that indexes Ukrainian finance events with dates, venue and sometimes speaker counts; useful purely as a discovery net for events not announced on the association sites. Data quality is uneven and must be confirmed against the organiser.

entity_name: AppsRunTheWorld customer databases for Way4 and Oracle FLEXCUBE
source_name: AppsRunTheWorld customer databases for Way4 and Oracle FLEXCUBE
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator listing named institutions running Way4 and FLEXCUBE. Useful as a cross-check to build the vendor-to-bank mapping when neither the bank nor the vendor publishes a release; must be treated as low-authority and corroborated.

source_name: ITHub.ua — Ukrainian IT company/vacancy directory
why_relevant: Company directory with vacancy, salary and contact aggregation per employer; primarily an actor-map/pointer resource for identifying fintech and payment-tech employers we have not yet enumerated, then following them onto Djinni/DOU.

source_name: ГО «Клуб банкірів»
why_relevant: A professional membership body of Ukrainian bankers; membership/board pages and event announcements function as a curated roster of senior banking figures and an entry point to smaller closed-door events not covered by media.
